commonQuestion.title: What you might want to know.

faqs.question: What is the programme fee, and what scholarships are available?
faqs.answer: The program fee is ₹3,85,000 per year. Scholarships up to 100% are available based on merit, sports, and other achievements. Early applicants receive scholarship priority.

faqs.question: Am I eligible? Do I need work experience?
faqs.answer: You need a bachelor's degree in any discipline. Work experience is welcome but not mandatory.

faqs.question: How is this different from other private MBA programmes in the NCR?
faqs.answer: Unlike traditional theoretical MBA programs, this program is designed for the next decade. It features a curriculum co-delivered with industry leaders (IBM, EY, IIDE), real field experience from the first semester, a guaranteed internship, and a portfolio of real-world deliverables rather than just a transcript.

faqs.question: What about placements?
faqs.answer: KRMU has a dedicated placement cell with a network of 800+ recruiters. The highest package across the university is ₹56.6 LPA. A built-in Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) pathway is integrated into the Year-Two Capstone project.

faqs.question: What kind of internships and projects will I work on?
faqs.answer: You will work on real-world business diagnoses of three companies, complete an 8-10 week corporate internship with joint guidance from academic and industry mentors, and finalize a capstone project solving a strategic challenge for a host client.

faqs.question: Who is this MBA not for?
faqs.answer: This program is not for those looking for a theoretical, passive classroom experience or a simple checklist degree. It demands rigor, hard work, an open mind, active participation, and a commitment to producing high-quality work.
